about_the_game:
A unique fusion of block-building strategy and high-octane space battles.
In Tenvader, you don’t just pilot a spaceship — you build it, block by block, in the middle of combat. Blast waves of alien invaders, collect stat blocks to upgrade your weapons, and survive against bosses that grow deadlier with each chaotic loop.

Every stage blends fast-paced bullet-dodging with Tetris-style block stacking. Match the right blocks to boost damage, shields, and speed, or unlock powerful weapons to turn the tide of battle.

Key Features:

  • Block-Build Combat – Earn and place stat blocks in real time to upgrade your ship mid-battle.

  • Weapon System – Unlock and enhance a variety of powerful weapons to adapt to the battlefield.

  • Multi-Loop Boss Battles – Face evolving bosses that learn new skills and alter the battlefield after each loop.

  • Special Stages & Mini Quests – Take a break from the main fight with bonus rounds, risky rewards, and unique challenges.

  • Endless Replayability – Every loop brings fresh patterns, effects, and strategies to master.

Whether you want a quick shoot ’em up run or aim to conquer all five loops for the ultimate challenge, Tenvader delivers a chaotic blend of skill, strategy, and space-faring madness in one seamless adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7360U or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630 or Better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5600G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or better
